items.rationale: Call 2 re-sends everything: 800 + 50 + 100 + 250 = 1,200. An answer of 250 or 350 forgets that the model keeps nothing between calls.
Each session starts with an empty window and the model keeps nothing; only something written to storage and read back can cross.

The set is over the 200,000-token guidance, and only a little is needed, so retrieve a few chunks. Pasting everything bills it every call; a one-time summary can drop details; notes are for facts the agent writes, not a fixed manual.

items.answer: The window, notes and retrieval: e.g. instructions in the window, a student's training status in notes, the machine manual by retrieval.
accepted: context window, notes file, retrieved manual chunks
the window, saved notes and retrieval
items.rationale: Any sensible example per place is fine: window for what every call needs, notes for small facts that must outlast a session, retrieval for large documents of which little is needed.

items.answer: A keyword search such as BM25, because it matches the exact string H-17.
accepted: keyword search because it matches the exact code
items.rationale: Meaning-based search can miss exact codes; keyword search matches the string, and combining both covers both kinds of question.
